title.provenance: AN ACT RELATING TO HEALTH AND SAFETY -- TOXIC PACKAGING REDUCTION ACT

status.provenance: Introduced By: Representatives Cortvriend, Speakman, Carson, Morales, Marszalkowski,  McGaw, Ruggiero,  Fogarty, Donovan, and Kislak

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: No food package to which PFAS have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution in any amount shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state.

date.provenance: Effective January 1, 2024, no food package to which PFAS have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution in any amount shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state.
